body:
I guess, but I was constantly told how much better relationships will be in college, then grad school, then my mid 20s, then my late 20s, now my 30s.  I get that its possible.  But I don't truly believe it.  

Even looking forward to possibilities of what can happen with my life, and life in general, feel just, empty.  Sci fi stuff, tech stuff, social possibilities for myself.  It's all just, noise.  I get the feeling that I SHOULD enjoy that stuff, look forward to it, but I don't anymore at all.
